name: FFmpeg
description: Decoding, conversion and analysis. Built with --enable-version3 and without --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree, so it is used under the LGPL v3 or later. Built from github.com/sk3llo/ffmpeg-kit-flutter (Maven com.antonkarpenko:ffmpeg-kit-full 2.2.1). FFmpeg source: ffmpeg.org.
